feedback.title: Add GitHub / Code Portfolio Link
feedback.description: Recruiters expect a link to your public code repositories for SDE roles.
feedback.suggestion: Include GitHub profile (e.g., github.com/username) in the header contact line.

feedback.title: Use Strong Action Verbs
feedback.description: Several bullet points use weak passive phrasing like "was responsible for" or "helped with".
feedback.suggestion: Begin bullet points with decisive action verbs like Architected, Engineered, Optimized, or Spearheaded.

feedback.title: Missing Quantifiable Metrics
feedback.description: Bullet points list responsibilities rather than measured outcomes.
feedback.suggestion: Add hard metrics like percentage improvements, throughput scale (e.g. 10k users), or time saved.

feedback.title: Missing Essential Software Development Engineer Keywords
feedback.description: Key industry terms missing from your skills section: data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, system design.
feedback.suggestion: Add relevant experience or project bullets demonstrating proficiency in data structures & algorithms.

feedback.title: Strong Metric Quantifiers

feedback.title: Missing System Design Keywords

feedback.title: Avoid Graphic Icons or Columns
